item.text: The project page now shows the saved default in a three-option selector, and archived pages render it disabled. The server persists edits and reads the project default when inserting tasks; I’ve also kept default changes independent of the existing filter selections. I’m reviewing the final diff and committing it now.

item.text:
Implemented Task 008 and committed as `94fa56ae0f2171d0ffe4241e4bf4e26963d8b6ce`.

Projects now persist a default task priority, which new tasks inherit. The selector remains disabled for archived projects, and changing the default preserves the selected task filters. Existing projects receive the `Normal` default through a SQLite migration.

Run with `npm start` (set `PORT` and `DB_PATH` as needed). `node --check server.js` passed, and `git status --porcelain` is clean.
